definitions.gloss: such, that kind of, like that
definitions.explanation: Refers to something distant from both speaker and listener, or something previously mentioned. Part of the ko-so-a-do demonstrative system.

examples.japanese: あんな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なりたくない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to become that kind of person.

examples.japanese: あんな⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}わなかった→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I didn't think it would be that expensive.
examples.notes: あんなに = to that extent

examples.japanese: あんな⟦{所|ところ}→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きたくない→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to go to a place like that.

examples.japanese: あんな⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}みたい→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦なあ→なあ：29262_naa⟧。
examples.english: I wish I could live in a big house like that.

examples.japanese: あんなふう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{踊|おど}れる→踊る：01250_odoru⟧⟦よう→よう：01114_you⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたいです→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to be able to dance that well.

notes:
あんな is part of the ko-so-a-do demonstrative system and refers to things/people distant from both speaker and listener.

KO-SO-A-DO PATTERN:
- ⟦こんな→こんな：02881_konna⟧: this kind of (near speaker)
- ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧: that kind of (near listener)
- あんな: that kind of (far from both)
- ⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧: what kind of (question)

FORMS:
- あんな⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: to that extent, that much
- あんなふう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in that way/manner

Note: あんな often carries a negative or dismissive nuance, especially when referring to people.
